## Checklist

- [ ] I edited `data/entries/*.yml` (not the README tables) or only prose/guides.
- [ ] Links use HTTPS and contain no affiliate, referral, or tracking parameters.
- [ ] Descriptions are factual, one sentence, and free of marketing language.
- [ ] If an entry's website moves to a different domain, I linked evidence that the new domain belongs to the same organization.
- [ ] I updated `last_verified` for any entry I checked against the provider's site.
- [ ] I dedicate my contribution to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
